senses.gloss: चे॑द् ind. (Padap. च इद्) (never found at the beginning of a sentence or verse) = च, ‘and’, AV. ii, 30, 2 (चे॑द्-च, ‘as well as’), xviii, 2, 37
‘when’ (the verb being accentuated, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 30), RV. vii, 74, 4; viii, 79, 5; x, 109, 3; AV. v, 17, 8

‘if’ (the verb being accentuated, cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 30; with pr. [AV. xii, 4, 21; ŚBr. &c.; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 8 f. & 132, Kāś.] Subj. [AV. vi, 122, 2], Pot. [xii, 4, 48; ŚBr. xiv; Mn. &c. (for Cond., MBh. v, 960 & Rājat. v, 478); cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 9 and 156, Kāś.], perf. [AV. vi, 51, 3; MBh. xii, 986 ff.; perf. p., Pāṇ. iii, 3, 132, Kāś.], aor. [AV. iv, 28, 4; xii, 4, 18; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 132, Kāś.], fut. [ŚBr. i, xiv; MBh.; R.; Śak.; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 8 f.; 132 f. and 156, Kāś.], Cond. [MBh. vii, 3423; Śak.; cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 139, Kāś.], perf. or fut. Pass. p. or with an auxiliary verb to be supplied, AV. ix, 5, 6; xii, 2, 36; KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.)
अथ चेद् ‘but if’, MBh. v, 2775; Bhag. ii, 33; xviii, 58
अपि चेद् ‘even’, Hariv. 11308
इति चेन् (often placed at the end of an objector's statement) ‘if it be argued that …’, न ‘no, it is not so’, Bādar. ii, 1, 35; Sarvad. ii, 158

न चेद् (g. चादि, also separated by the verb [MBh.] or the verb preceded by न placed at the end of the sentence [ŚBr. xiv, 6, 8, 1; Bhag. ii, 33; xviii, 58; Hit.], rarely चेन् न in reversed order beginning the apodosis, Sāṃkhyak. 1; Sāh.; Śrut.; Hit.) ‘if not’ (= नो चेद् forming a sentence by itself, ŚBr. xiv, 7, 2, 15), ŚBr. xiv; ŚāṅkhŚr. i, 17, 1; Mn. &c.

नो चेद् (g. चादि) id. (forming a sentence by itself. e.g. दूरम् अपसर नो चेद् धन्तव्यो ऽसि मया, ‘depart to a distance, if not i.e. if thou departest not, thou art to be killed by me’), MBh. xii, 7, 21 and 29, 145; Pañcat.; Kathās.; Vet.; Hit.
नो चेद् exceptionally = न चेद् (beginning a sentence), MBh. xiii, 5809
न चेद् or नो चेद् (with Pot.) ‘would that not!’ (e.g. नो चेत् प्रदहेत्, ‘would that he did not burn down!’), v, 676 ff. and 966
न चेद् or नो चेद् (with pr. or Pot., the apodosis containing an Impv.) ‘if not’ i.e. ‘in order that not’, 2714; RV. v, 80, 24
यदि चेद् (also separated by the verb) = चेद्, ‘if’ (with pr. Pot. fut.), MBh. i, 2403; Hariv. 11895; R. ii, 8, 34 and 48, 19 (cf. नेद्.)

चेदि॑ m. pl. N. of a people (who lived in Bundelkhand; renowned for their attachment to ancient laws and institutions, MBh.; their capital was Śuktimatī; some of their kings were Vasu Uparicara, Subāhu, Dhṛṣṭa-ketu, Dama-ghoṣa, Śiśu-pāla &c.), RV. viii, 5, 39; MBh.; R. &c.
चेदि॑ m. sg. N. of the supposed ancestor of the Cedis (son of Kaiśika or Uśika), BhP. ix, 24, 2.
चेदि—नगरी f. = त्रि-पुरी, L.
चेदि—प m. = -पति, MBh. i, 2342; iii, 462; VarBṛS. xliii, 8
N. of a son of Vasu Uparicara, BhP. ix, 22, 6.
चेदि—पति m. a prince of the Cedis, MBh. iii (Nal. xvi, 31), xiii.
चेदि—पुरी f. the city of the Cedis ii, 1508; Nal. xvi, 6.
चेदि—भू-भुज् m. ‘earth-enjoyer of the Cedis’, = -पति, BhP. vii, 1, 13.
चेदि—भूभृत् m. ‘protector of the country of the Cedis’, Śiśu-pāla, W.
चेदि—राज् m. ‘king of the Cedis’ id., L.
= -पति, MBh. iii, 898.
चेदि—राज m. = -पति, Nal. xii f.; Hariv. 4964; BhP. ix, 24, 38 Śiśu-pāla, W.
चेदि—विषय m. the country of the Cedis, MBh. i, 2335.
चेदि-संवत् see कलचुरि-संवत्सर, p. 1324.
चेदि—हूण m. pl. the Cedis and the Hūṇas, Mudr.
चेदिक m. pl. the Cedis, VarBṛS. xiv, 8.
